title: Kernel auto-selection v2: add model-family classifier and architecture tags
author: Yuki Sato
description: Context: Kernel auto-selection v2 relies on stable, explainable feature signals. This PR adds a lightweight model-family classifier that produces a canonical `model_family` + `arch_tags` from the loaded model config/metadata and threads that signal into the selector rules. The classifier is designed to be deterministic, cheap (no weights inspection), and resilient to common finetune/variant naming patterns. Summary of changes: (1) Introduce `ModelFamily` enum (LLAMA, MISTRAL, QWEN2, GEMMA, UNKNOWN) and `ArchTags` (e.g., `rope`, `gqa`, `moe`, `sliding_window`, `long_context`) derived from config fields such as `model_type`, `architectures`, `rope_scaling`, `num_key_value_heads`, and attention impl hints. (2) Add normalization and variant handling: recognize common finetune prefixes/suffixes ("-instruct", "-chat", "-it", "-sft"), vendor forks ("vicuna", "openhermes", "nous", "dolphin"), and local registry names; prefer explicit config fields over string matching; fall back to UNKNOWN if signals disagree. (3) Route the feature into v2 candidate generation: selection rules now include per-family kernel preferences (e.g., LLAMA/GQA-friendly decode kernel, MISTRAL sliding-window prefill kernel) while maintaining existing v1 behavior when v2 is gated off. (4) Add unit tests and golden fixtures for representative configs and edge cases; tests assert determinism (same input config -> same family/tags) and ensure we do not misclassify long-context variants that require different prefill kernels. Notes: This PR intentionally avoids adding any learned/scoring logic; it only makes the family/tag signal available so the rule-based selector can remain explainable and debuggable. Follow-ups: ENG-4823 will consume GPU SKU + driver gates; ENG-4824 will add per-request telemetry fields including `model_family` and `arch_tags` with sampling controls.
commits: runtime/selector: add ModelFamily + ArchTags types and classifier entrypoint
runtime/model-meta: normalize model name variants; prefer config.model_type/architectures
runtime/selector: plumb model_family into v2 candidate generation
tests: add classifier fixtures + determinism tests
docs(internal): selector feature signals updated (model_family + arch_tags)
notable_snippets: Pseudo-code: family = from(config.model_type || architectures[0]); tags = { rope: rope_scaling!=null, gqa: num_key_value_heads < num_attention_heads, sliding_window: sliding_window!=null, moe: num_experts>0 }; if conflicting signals -> UNKNOWN + tag_conflict=true (logged at debug).
Rule hook: if (features.model_family == LLAMA && features.tags.gqa) prefer Kernel::FlashDecodeGQA over Kernel::FlashDecodeGeneric for decode path (still subject to SKU/denylist in later PRs).
testing: Unit: model_family_classifier_test (golden fixtures for Llama2/3/3.1, Mistral 7B + Mixtral config shape, Qwen2, Gemma; plus finetune naming variants)
Manual: ran local selector trace dump on llama-3.1-70b-instruct config (no kernel selection change without v2 gate enabled)
review_conversation: Hiro Tanaka: Can we avoid name-based heuristics as much as possible? I’d like config-first classification, otherwise forks will be painful. Also please document precedence rules.

Yuki Sato (author): Yep—updated classifier to prefer `model_type` and `architectures` and only use name normalization when those are missing/empty. Added a short precedence section to the doc and a test for a forked "vicuna" name with llama config fields.

Noah Patel: Concern: misclassifying long-context llama variants could cause tail spikes once seq buckets are introduced. Can we add a tag that explicitly captures rope scaling / context length signals even if family is LLAMA?

Yuki Sato (author): Added `long_context` + `rope_scaling_present` tags derived from rope_scaling + max_position_embeddings delta. Selector rules in this PR don’t change behavior based on that yet, but the signal is now available for the long-context guardrails in ENG-4825/PR-28522.
Lena Fischer: Please include a fixture for sliding-window attention (Mistral style) and ensure we don’t accidentally tag it as generic rope long-context. That distinction matters for prefill kernels.
Yuki Sato (author): Added sliding-window fixture and explicit `sliding_window` tag; tests assert it remains set even if rope_scaling is present.
Marcus Reed: Any measurable overhead? This is on request path eventually (feature extraction).

Yuki Sato (author): Classifier runs at model load time and emits cached features; request path uses the cached `SelectorFeatures`. Added a micro-benchmark stub note; overhead is negligible in profiling (<0.01ms at load).
Hiro Tanaka: LGTM after the precedence doc + one more test for conflicting signals (e.g., bad config).
Yuki Sato (author): Added `conflicting_signals_falls_back_to_unknown` test; we still emit tags but set family=UNKNOWN and mark conflict for debug logging.
Noah Patel: Approved. Please ensure the selector remains deterministic and that logging is debug-only.
Yuki Sato (author): Done—no randomness, stable ordering, and logs are behind `RUNTIME_LOG_LEVEL=debug`.
release_notes: Internal-only: Kernel auto-selection v2 feature extraction now includes model_family + arch_tags (LLAMA/MISTRAL/QWEN2/GEMMA/UNKNOWN) for routing into rule-based kernel preferences when v2 is enabled via feature gate.
